user.title: Connect to SmartHome Core
user.description: Enter the Core URL and bearer token. Core must expose protocol version 1. Timer outputs map an assist satellite to its ESPHome timer exchange action; Home Assistant calls that output's action to deliver timer announcements. Example: {"assist_satellite.kitchen": "esphome.kitchen_smarthome_timer_exchange_v1"}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Core. Check its URL and availability.
error.unsupported_protocol: Core does not support protocol version 1.
error.invalid_timer_outputs: Map assist_satellite entities to unique esphome actions ending in _smarthome_timer_exchange_v1. Finish or cancel active timers before changing their bindings.

init.title: Satellite output bindings and timer outputs
init.description: Bindings route announcements through gateway satellites. Timer outputs map each assist satellite to an ESPHome timer exchange action; Home Assistant calls that output's action to deliver timer announcements. Example: {"assist_satellite.kitchen": "esphome.kitchen_smarthome_timer_exchange_v1"}.

error.invalid_bindings: Each binding must map a non-empty source ID to a non-empty gateway satellite ID.
error.invalid_timer_outputs: Map assist_satellite entities to unique esphome actions ending in _smarthome_timer_exchange_v1. Finish or cancel active timers before changing their bindings.
